author: umbridgerro131
quote: I like the gameplay, I like the game as a whole - but then there is the performance. Playing a game with unstable 30 FPS, forced on a Console in 2026 is pathetic and ridiculous. The game is very buggy, and you get a headache if you play it for a longer time as its so stuttery and laggy. Also very cringe to delay the PC release just to **** out more money from their community. The story does not hold up aswell, and the Critic Reviews are clearly bought/manipulated in some way by R*. Without upscaling/massive tricks this game looks like absolute crap on Console (it would look great on PC or with good Hardware generally speaking) - but as is, blurry and not really good. The game itself does not feel like GTA, but more like a Chore Simulator. The game has clear potential, but unplayable as-is for a long time for anyone who has standards & is used to higher framerates (e.g 240 fps) due to competitive shooters or similar. The game is also very realistic in very niche and specific cases, but then after you have been shot like 10 times, almost bled out, you run around and kill 200 cops while in a wheel chair after escaping from an ICU. Makes 0 sense.
